title: Text Volume Chapter 602 Murder
content:
Text Volume Chapter 602 Murder

Fusu brought 5,000 people into Liaodong. According to the suggestion in Heifu's letter, he left more than 4,000 Zhao soldiers in Xi'anping.

But for the five thousand Yan soldiers, Chen Ping gave the suggestion that if they were also placed in Xi'anping, it would be easy for the soldiers of Yan and Zhao to collude.

"Once they start a rebellion, there will be an extra group of tens of thousands of rebel soldiers in Liaodong, and there will be no peace in the north. Why don't you take the Yan soldiers to North Korea and let them guard the mouth of the line, firstly to facilitate the supply by sea, and secondly to make the country more peaceful?" North Korea and Yan soldiers are wary of each other, so they can ensure a safe future..."

After hearing this, Fusu thought it made sense, and asked several captains again. They also felt that Chen Ping's strategy was very pertinent, so they readily adopted it.

But now, this move has caused a catastrophe...

The Qin army's camp under Man Fanhan was divided into two major camps: the left and right. Yan soldiers were stationed on the left, separated by a ravine and a wooden wall, and the Guanzhong soldiers were stationed on the right, tightly surrounding the sentry tower where Fusu lived.

Fusu stood on the sentry tower and looked out, only to see that all the soldiers of the Qin camp on the right had been awakened, arranged in an array according to the organizational structure, and guarded the camp as if they were facing a powerful enemy.

However, the Yanzu camp on the left was completely out of order. There were people running around everywhere, mixed with noisy shouts, the sound of weapons clashing, and even the tents were on fire. The scene was chaotic.

"This is Yingxiao..."

Fusu opened his eyes wide and watched this scene.

The captain named Gao Cheng told him that this was the most terrifying civil strife in the army. The trek that lasts thousands of miles is getting farther and farther away from home, but getting closer and closer to the unknown foreign battlefield. The loss was too great when crossing thousands of mountains. People in almost every village died or were killed for fleeing. In addition, the deputy general Yang Duanhe fell ill and died, which aggravated the tension among the soldiers of Yan and Zhao in the camp. The safest generals were all dead. , let alone them?

The reason why there was no chaos was entirely due to the suppression of the five thousand Guanzhong elites and strict military discipline.

Seeing that they are about to enter North Korea, everyone is waiting for safety. Therefore, on such a quiet and dark night, a soldier's cry due to nightmares or fear will often trigger a chain reaction of others, causing the entire military camp to fall into a state of hysteria.

The soldiers may have thought that the camp was being attacked, and in panic, they took up weapons and attacked others indiscriminately. Some people had evil intentions and wanted to take advantage of the opportunity to escape, so they killed each other and trampled on each other in the camp. demon.

"Thanks to the Guanzhong soldiers who have been on the battlefield for a long time, they were not implicated by Ying Xiao."

Captain Gao wiped his sweat secretly. This was a blessing among misfortunes. If it affected the young master Fusu and caused him to suffer some evil, then his ten heads would not be enough to chop him off.

Fusu looked at this scene and just wanted to look up to the sky and sigh. This expedition was really disastrous. As a supervisor in the northern part of the Great Wall a few years ago, he thought he had gone deep into the military camp and understood the pain of the expedition, but this time suddenly After being appointed as the chief general by his father, he realized that when he was the supervisor of the army before, it was just a child's game of traveling with the army.

The urgent war time, the heavy weight of more than 10,000 lives on our shoulders, the supplies that may run out at any time, the journey that seems to be endless every day, and the sudden accidents that follow one after another.

In just four months, Fusu has experienced hardship and fear that he has not experienced in the past twenty years. This is just a march, not a formal war yet...

If he were a pawn, facing such huge pressure, he might not be able to help but let out a long suppressed roar, right?

Seeing that the chaos in the left camp was getting worse, more and more people were being trampled and killed, and the fire was almost spreading to the right camp. Fusu looked at the captains: "Gentlemen, is there any way to stop it?"

"stop?"

The two captains looked at each other, and Gao Cheng smiled bitterly and said: "This camp roar is similar to a prison roar. Once it happens, it is extremely difficult to stop it. If you enter the camp rashly, you may be attacked by soldiers. The best way..."

A ruthless look flashed in his eyes: "Send someone to occupy the camp gate, lock the soldiers inside overnight, and let them kill each other! By tomorrow morning, the young master will have a quiet camp."

In the eyes of the Qin people, it was inexplicable to bring these soldiers of Yan and Zhao to fight in a foreign country. It only increased the difficulty. It would be better to die. It would be better if they all died, so as to save them from worries!

Fusu was silent for a long time. It is true that the advice of the captains was the best way to protect the Qin soldiers in the right camp, but Fusu finally sighed:

"Before the war started, the deputy general, Old General Yang, fell ill and died. One or two out of ten people who marched thousands of miles died. Now the camp is roaring, and another third is about to lose. How is this different from abandoning the army and losing the division? One general is incompetent, and the three armies are suffering, saying Fusu, right? But no matter what, they are my soldiers and my innocent sons, Fusu cannot abandon them!"

He took one last look at the chaotic Zuoying and ordered:

"Gather the chariots and horses, all heavily armored, and follow me into the left camp to separate the soldiers!"

"Young master, no!"

The captains quickly tried to dissuade him, but Fusu was determined.

When he put on the heavy armor, stood on the military chariot, and glanced at the five thousand Guanzhong soldiers who were as stable as a rock, he couldn't help but sigh. He had always wanted his father to treat the land of Qin and the homeland of the Six Kingdoms equally. Along the way, he also We continue to practice this and hope that the three armed forces can work together in the same boat.

But the fact is, how can hundreds of years of estrangement and generations of hatred be eliminated overnight? Once something happens, the most reliable ones are the disciples of Guanzhong...

Fu Su made a long salute to these five thousand Guanzhong soldiers!

But on the other hand, he could understand the fear in the camper's heart.

This expedition was too long and too hard, and the emperor's deployment was strange, as if the soldiers from the three places were deliberately brought together to test Fusu for various problems that occurred during the use.

From the commander-in-chief to the soldiers, everyone's nerves were highly tense. An unfamiliar territory, harsh military laws, and the precarious trust between the Yan people and the Qin people. In the dream, the distant hometown and the bloody fight close at hand, the long journey with uncertain life and death, many familiar faces disappeared, and under the high-pressure military discipline, the depression can only accumulate for a long time.

Until the tight string broke!

With someone's scream, all the fear, anger, and confusion that had been hidden for a long time burst out in an instant and became unstoppable.

Fusu could understand, but even so, he had to stop this terrible incident!

The young master raised his sword and ordered: "Strike the gold! Open the camp gate!"

The strong men ring the bronze bell in the camp. This is a signal to withdraw the troops and stop the fighting. The sharp sound is also a good way to wake up the roaring soldiers in the camp.

At the left camp, some hurried and frightened soldiers heard the sound of the golden bell and subconsciously stopped their weapons, raised their heads, or turned their faces. But they saw that the previously closed right camp was wide open. In the night, a military chariot and horses were leading the way, followed by Guanzhong soldiers wearing armor and holding torches. They rushed straight into the left camp, shouting in unison:

"The general has an order, abandon your troops and lie down on the ground!"

Under Jin Minghe's shouts, many people woke up with a start, obeyed, threw away their blood-stained weapons, and crawled on the ground. After calming down, they looked at the corpses on the ground with fear. No one knew what happened just now. In the darkness, in their madness, did they accidentally kill their own country party leader...

Fusu's chariot and Qin's soldiers passed in front of them without stopping.

But in Zuoying, there are still many places where terrible killings are taking place. Some people are red-eyed and ignore it, while others want to fight their way out of the camp and escape from this hard labor completely!

The chaos in Zuoying did not improve. Some people were even crazy enough to attack the Qin soldiers who were quelling the chaos, and wanted to pull Fusu out of the chariot. The guards fought desperately to protect each other, and only then could Fusu be saved.

Fusu knew that the time had come to make a choice.

"Those who kill each other are guilty of the same crime as a private fight. Kill them!"

"Anyone who blocks it will be considered as treasonous and will be killed!"

"Those who cross the camp will be considered as fleeing and will be killed!"

Three words of "kill" came out of Fusu's mouth with difficulty. He could imagine that if Qin Shihuang saw this scene, he would definitely praise him for killing him...

Relying on killing to solve problems was what Fusu hated and opposed the most.

But it's not that easy to stop a chaos. Sometimes, some people have to die in order to let most people live!

"kill……"

It's such a terrible feeling to be forced into someone you once hated.

Fusu had tears in his eyes, and the sword in his hand was pointed at the soldiers who were trapped in fear and madness, and at his former self!

"kill!"

…

A few days later, in Xi'anping, two hundred miles to the west, Chen Ping listened quietly to the messenger telling what happened in Manfanhan.

"There was a loud roar in the left camp. Five thousand Yan soldiers were killing and trampling each other. The young master wore armor and held a sword. He led the armored soldiers into the camp to quell the chaos. He killed hundreds of people and the chaos stopped..."

In short, this camp roar was miraculously calmed down by Fusu. Afterwards, the number of people was reduced, and they killed each other and trampled on each other. At least a thousand people died, and more than a thousand people fled in the chaos. The leader was a Yan people named "Wei Man".

The reason for Yingxiao has also been found out. Rumors have been circulating in the camp recently that "the emperor's Eastern Expedition was a lie and he wanted to make the people of Yan and Zhao die to make it true." The soldiers of Yan were frightened, and Wei Man and others wanted to escape, so they took the opportunity to roar at night, trying to cause chaos and take the opportunity to escape. However, the falsehood came true, triggering this tragedy...

Wei Man and more than a thousand people rushed out of the camp and fled westward. Fusu was unable to catch up, so he sent a messenger to inform Xi'an, where the granary was located, to be careful of rioters.

"Is everything okay, sir?"

Chen Ping was very concerned about Fusu's safety.

The envoy replied: "Young master has nothing to do. He just rushed into the camp personally. He was attacked by a group of soldiers, fought with them, and killed two people..."

Chen Ping could imagine that Fusu's sword, which was polished clean every day, was stained with blood for the first time.

"Unexpected..."

After the messenger retreated, Chen Ping sighed.

That rumor was secretly spread by him when he was in Xi'an. In other words, it was actually the truth.

Chen Ping originally just wanted to make Fusu's already tortuous expedition more difficult, causing the young master to become confused and bewildered, and finally let the black husband of Jiaodong clean up the mess for him.

"In this case, not only Qin Shi Huang will be disappointed with the eldest son, but the Lord may also give up on Fusu completely..."

Now it seems that it is self-defeating. Everything that follows is out of Chen Ping's control. Even he doesn't know in what direction things will develop...

Scratching his itchy scalp, Chen Ping laughed to himself: "The master still sees clearly. If you talk too much, you will definitely make mistakes!"
